title: Million-Atom Ab Initio Electron Dynamics: Discontinuous Galerkin Real-Time Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory
problem: Real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) has been limited to thousands of atoms due to computational and communication scaling challenges. Higher accuracy requires simulation of million-atom systems.
motivation: Understanding ultrafast electron dynamics in large-scale materials and nanophotonic devices requires simulating systems with millions of atoms. Previous methods were limited to thousands of atoms, preventing study of many important systems.
method: Novel rt-TDDFT method using discontinuous Galerkin adaptive local basis. Reduces global communication via basis locality. Tensor compression technique leverages basis locality to avoid repeated multi-center integral evaluation in hybrid functionals. Fused Gemm-Reduce operation optimizes projection.
key_novelty: Discontinuous Galerkin approach for communication reduction; tensor compression exploiting basis locality; fused Gemm-Reduce kernel achieving high floating-point efficiency; million-atom simulation capability.
contributions: Discontinuous Galerkin adaptive local basis for rt-TDDFT
Reduced global communication via basis locality
Tensor compression technique for multi-center integrals
Fused Gemm-Reduce operation for projection optimization
High floating-point efficiency (several times higher than standard BLAS)
Support for local-semi-local and hybrid functionals
Two orders of magnitude improvement in computational scale
34.8% of theoretical peak performance on Sunway (524,288 CGs)

metrics.scale_improvement: Two orders of magnitude (from thousands to millions of atoms)
metrics.speedup_vs_blas: Several times higher floating-point efficiency vs standard BLAS

baselines: Previous rt-TDDFT methods limited to thousands of atoms
limitations: Simulation complexity still high; hybrid functional overhead remains significant; extreme-scale results on specific architecture (Sunway); application-specific performance tuning.
